name: Runemaster Mind Over Matter lengthens the Ley Lock school lockout by 0.5 sec (#1358)
contract: Mind Over Matter 802669 (passive): 'Increases the duration of Ley Lock by $/1000;S1 sec.' Its only effect is a
native flat SPELLMOD_DURATION with BasePoints 499 + DieSides 1 = +500 ms on family 38 mask2 0x80000, which only
Ley Lock 800995 carries. Ley Lock is a single SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST with DurationIndex 66 (2500 ms school
lockout), a 500 ms cast and FacingCasterFlags 1. Spell::EffectInterruptCast sizes the lockout from
CalcSpellDuration and ModSpellDuration, neither of which reads the caster's SPELLMOD_DURATION modifiers (only
aura durations get them in Aura::CalcMaxDuration), so the talent changed nothing. Player::ProhibitSpellSchool
puts every known spell of the interrupted school on cooldown for the lockout, so a player target's Frostbolt
cooldown measures it. Expected: an interrupted Frostbolt locks the Frost school for 2.5 sec without the talent
and for 3 sec with it. Fixture: a PvP-flagged Undead mage faces the PvP-flagged human Runemaster 3 yd away and
casts Frostbolt 116 (1.5 sec) at it; the Runemaster answers with Ley Lock, which lands mid-cast.

steps.label: Without the talent Ley Lock keeps its 2.5 sec lockout
SETUP: the mage is casting Frostbolt
SETUP: Ley Lock interrupts the Frostbolt
Without the talent the Frost school is locked for 2.5 sec
SETUP: the interrupted Frostbolt never landed
Mind Over Matter's modifier covers Ley Lock
SETUP: the mage is casting Frostbolt again
SETUP: Ley Lock is cast again
SETUP: Ley Lock interrupts the second Frostbolt
Mind Over Matter locks the Frost school for 3 sec
